summary: Frontend-only i18n verification of /citadelle/estimation for the new EN translations. Tested FR default, switch to EN via data-testid='lang-switcher', all key labels (hero, estimator, professional form, cards, multiples table, FAQ, CTA), estimator functionality in EN (calc + adjustment labels), 'Other asset types' panel, localStorage persistence ('citadelle_lang'), and toggle-back to FR. Result: translation is complete and correct — no French residue detected in EN mode.

issues: Multiple React hydration warnings caused by the visual-editor injected <span data-ve-dynamic="true"> wrappers around <option>, <th>, <tr>, <td> and <tbody> nodes (SITE_TYPES / AGES array mappings). These are visual-editor tooling markers, not from i18n code, but they pollute the console with 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <select>/<thead>/<tbody>' errors. Consider disabling ve-dynamic wrapping for table/select children or wrapping arrays with Fragment-only children.

action_items: None blocking. Estimation page i18n is complete and correct in both FR and EN. Optional: address the pre-existing hydration warnings from the visual editor injection (not caused by this iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: estimation JSON keys are well-scoped under 'estimation.*'; helpers siteTypes(t)/ages(t)/extraTypes(t)/divOptions(t) and compute(t,...) correctly receive t and return translated labels — verified by finding 'Solid SEO 30–60%', 'Stable 0–5%/mo', '2 revenue sources' in EN after calculation.

Badge strings 'Free tool · Professional SDE method' / 'Outil gratuit · Méthode SDE professionnelle' render UPPERCASE via CSS text-transform (rendered as 'FREE TOOL · PROFESSIONAL SDE METHOD') — this is expected styling, not an i18n bug.
localStorage key 'citadelle_lang' correctly persists; page in EN survives full reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 30 validated the FR/EN toggle on /citadelle/estimation only. All labels (hero, estimator with 5 params, pro form + Standard/Expert cards + Recommended badge, multiples table with age headers and site types, 5-question FAQ, final CTA) translate correctly. Estimator adjustments (compute()) also translate. No French residue in EN mode. Persistence via localStorage 'citadelle_lang' works. Only cosmetic note: visual-editor injections cause React hydration warnings on <select>/<table> — pre-existing, not related to i18n. Screenshots taken at .screenshots/est_fr.png and .screenshots/est_en.png.
